phrases.latin: Quās avia Theodōrō mōnstrāvit: «Olīvae sunt. Ex olīvīs oleum fit.»
phrases.english: Grandma showed them to Theo: “They’re olives. Oil is made from olives.”
phrases.source: Libellus III, Apud avum et aviam

sources: Lewis & Short: oliva · Lewis & Short: olea
